messages:
amanda: Heads up — noticed console charts getting stuttery around 17:03 UTC. Frames drop and then occasional full chart re-render.
kevin: seen it too, started ~17:02. CPU on the client spikes. Any recent telemetry rollouts?
rajesh: we shipped the telemetry sampler tweak at 16:55 (rollout 20%). It increases per-route event flush frequency to help debug evictions.
sylvie: that sampler was supposed to be lightweight. Could it cause bundle work?
amanda: attaching quick flame snapshot (client-side). Looks like telemetry event reducer loop triggers a big memo invalidation and then chart rebind.
amanda: ```
main.js: reduceTelemetryEvents -> recomputeRouteMeta -> invalidateChartCache -> rerenderCharts x N
CPU ~ 80% for 500ms
```
kevin: ah yeah the invalidateChartCache path does a deep keys comparison. If telemetry events are more frequent, it hits frequently.
rajesh: rollout might be too aggressive. It flushes every 2s for high-sensitivity routes. Should be 10s in prod.
sylvie: also seeing a CDN spiky 304/200 oscillation in the network panel — some assets getting revalidated often. Cache-control header changed in last deploy?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-19T16:50 by rajesh - frontend telemetry-sampler v1.3.
kevin: @rajesh can we throttle the sampler to 10s for the entire rollout group?
rajesh: yes, can patch -> pushing canary update (10% -> 1.3.1) to increase interval. Doing it now.
amanda: quick workaround: client-side we can short-circuit invalidateChartCache if the incoming payload matches the last snapshot hash. Adds cheap check. Might prevent surge rerenders.
sylvie: good idea for a hotfix. Minimal risk.
kevin: also propose we add a debounce in the telemetry ingestion route on the client: batch events for 5s window then dispatch. Less immediate fidelity but stabilizes UI.
rajesh: canary patch deployed to 10% -> infra metrics show sampler events dropped 70% on canary.
infra-bot: infra-bot: canary health ok — p99 CPU down 40% on canary cohort.
amanda: rolling out client short-circuit hotfix now (small change in chart rendering guard).
sylvie: I'll monitor frontend telemetry for artifactual regressions. If stable for 20m we roll to 100%.
kevin: follow-up: we should add a code-path level quota for telemetry events per route per user to avoid noisy customers spamming flush frequency. Not a full rate-limit, just a soft quota that samples after threshold.
rajesh: agree. Also need to revert the sampler config change in config store until we have canary data.
amanda: patch merged and rolling. CDN header change rollback queued (it was from a static-assets deploy earlier today).
kevin: long-term: audit invalidateChartCache triggers. We should make it idempotent and rely on fine-grained KV updates instead of full-cache invalidation.
sylvie: filing follow-up ticket: "chart cache granularity + telemetry backpressure" and linking perf traces.
amanda: TL;DR: cause = telemetry sampler flush frequency + CDN revalidation -> repeated chart invalidations -> client CPU spikes -> perceived slow charts. Mitigations: canary sampler throttle, client short-circuit guard, rollback CDN header.
rajesh: rollout to 100% now for sampler tweak revert.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete.
amanda: monitoring: p50 frame time back to normal after 8m. Keeping eyes on it for next hour. :thumbsup:
kevin: nice catch. Let's sync tomorrow 10am for the follow-up design review.
